features.description: Balanced Rock is the park's iconic roadside sandstone formation near the south end of the scenic drive and the P15 parking area.

features.name: Siamese Twins
features.description: Siamese Twins is a paired sandstone formation reached by the natural-surface Siamese Twins Trail, with a framed view toward Pikes Peak through its window.
